hero.eyebrow: Five-night yoga & Pilates retreat · Xaló, Spain
hero.heading: Siesta & *Soul*
hero.intro: Five nights in the Xaló valley with Vanessa and Cara. Sunshine, a pool, an outdoor shala, long evening meals and a proper siesta. Yoga and Pilates available daily and nowhere you need to be.

invitation.heading: When did you last have a day with *nowhere to be?*
invitation.text:
Siesta & Soul is five nights tucked away among vineyards, olive and almond trees, an hour from Alicante airport and well away from the tourist strip. We'll have a gorgeous traditional villa to ourselves: a small, family-run villa with a pool, a help-yourself bar and an outdoor yoga shala looking out over the hills.

Mornings start with movement if you want it. Afternoons are for the pool and a siesta. Evenings are easy, and there's no need to change out of your yoga clothes for dinner.
invitation.for_you_heading: This retreat is for you if
for_you: You'd love a week of sunshine, good food and good company
You want to move every day, with varied options
You're new to yoga or Pilates, or you've practised for years
You're coming on your own (plenty of people do)
You'd like to book a shared room with a friend
You could do with a proper rest before summer really starts

stories.label: Were you stay
stories.heading: A villa that's *ours for the week*
stories.text: Cuatre Finques is a small, family-run villa in the Xaló valley, with nine en-suite rooms, a pool and gardens full of olive and almond trees. We have the whole place to ourselves. Each room has a sun hat, beach bag and pool towels waiting for you to use during your stay, and there's a little honesty bar for when the sun goes down.
stories.image_alt: A bright en-suite bedroom at Cuatre Finques with a view of the garden

stories.label: The yoga
stories.heading: Slow and spicy, *sun and shade*
stories.text: Vanessa's yoga and Cara's Pilates are made to work as a pair. Expect a gentle Land and Arrive practice, Happy Hour Yin, a sleepy Yoga Nidra after the beach and a two-hour Cayenne Mandala. Cara brings Sunrise Core, Spicy HIIT Pilates, Flamenco Barre and Fiesta Full Body. Every class is optional and all levels are welcome.

stories.label: The food
stories.heading: Long lunches and *slow suppers*
stories.text: Breakfast every morning, plus three lunches and four dinners at the villa, all made fresh in the villa kitchen. There's a tapas night, a light salad lunch by the pool and paella night with live music. Tea, coffee and water are there all day. Lunch on the beach day and dinner in Altea are out and about, so you can choose what you fancy.

host.heading: Hosted by *Vanessa & Cara.*
host.text:
Vanessa has run V Flow Yoga Studio in Clitheroe for six years and this is her next retreat after Ibiza and Greece. Her yoga classes are always themed, warm and welcoming, whatever your level.

Cara teaches Pilates and barre at V Flow Yoga. Her classes are upbeat, with plenty of focus on core and posture, and a good playlist.

You'll be looked after from the moment you land.
host.image_alt: Vanessa, founder of Vanessa Flow Yoga

travel.heading: Fly to Alicante
travel.text: We'll recommend one retreat flight there and back from Manchester, so we can travel together if you like. Book it yourself once your place is confirmed.

travel.heading: Shared minibus
travel.text: We'll arrange a minibus to meet the retreat flight. It's about an hour to the villa. You pay your share separately, nearer the time.

travel.heading: Arrive from 3pm
travel.text: Check-in is from 3pm on Wednesday 30 June, with our first yoga class at 5pm. Check-out is by 11am on Monday 5 July.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: Fill in the Save my spot form below. Vanessa will be in touch personally to talk you through the rooms and send the payment details.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: A £300 non-refundable deposit secures your place. Pay the rest in full, or in two equal payments by 26 February and 26 April 2027. All payments are by bank transfer.

faqs.question: When does the early bird end?
Can I come on my own?
faqs.answer: Yes, and plenty of people do. Most rooms are singles, so you'll have your own space and a ready-made group to share the week with.

faqs.question: I'm new to yoga and Pilates. Is that okay?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every class is for all levels and every class is optional, so you can join in as much or as little as you like.

faqs.question: Can I give a place as a gift?
faqs.answer: Yes. A place on Siesta & Soul makes a lovely Christmas present. Get in touch and we'll help you arrange it.

faqs.question: Are flights included?
faqs.answer: No. We'll recommend a flight from Manchester and arrange a shared minibus from Alicante airport that you can join.

enquiry.heading: Save your spot.
enquiry.intro: Send your details and Vanessa will be in touch personally. She'll talk you through the rooms, answer your questions and hold your place while you decide.

thank_you.heading: Your spot is saved. *That's with Vanessa & Cara.*
thank_you.message: Thank you for saying yes. Vanessa reads every one of these herself and will be in touch personally by email or phone.
